skill.name: discord-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Discord or needs workflows for server structure, roles and permissions, onboarding, moderation, bots, announcements, activity summaries, personal data packages, or Discord guidance. Routes each workflow by identity, authority, durable state, runtime availability, and policy among verified official app or bot APIs, webhooks, file tools, and manual guidance; normal-user-account automation through My Browser or Computer Use is not an execution route.
skill.userDescription: Plan and manage Discord communities, bots, moderation, and announcements.
exampleQuestions: Design roles and channels for a new Discord community.
Draft a moderation and onboarding plan for my Discord server.
Summarize activity from my exported Discord data.
